'''UsefulCharts''' is a chartmaking company founded by Canadian educator and designer '''Matt Baker'''. The company produces [[infographic]] posters both physically and digitally and has an associated storefront in [[Vancouver]] and a [[YouTube]] channel.

== Founder ==
'''Matthew James Baker'''<ref group="‡" name=":0">{{Cite thesis |last=Baker |first=Matthew James |title=Psychological type and atheism: why some people are more likely than others to give up God |date=2015 |publisher=University of Warwick |url=https://pugwash.lib.warwick.ac.uk:443/record=b2860410~S1 |place=Coventry}}</ref> is a Canadian<ref>{{Cite news |last=Diment |first=Marcia |date=2023-10-03 |title=Popular quirky YouTube channel has a Vancouver storefront |url=https://www.vancouverisawesome.com/local-news/popular-quirky-youtube-channel-vancouver-store-7652860 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240520210339/https://www.vancouverisawesome.com/local-news/popular-quirky-youtube-channel-vancouver-store-7652860 |archive-date=2024-05-20 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=Vancouver Is Awesome |issn=0832-218X}}</ref> educator and designer<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |last=Noe |first=Rain |date=2019-01-29 |title=Cool Charts Depicting the Evolution of the Alphabet, and the Writing Systems of the World |url=https://www.core77.com/posts/83175/Cool-Charts-Depicting-the-Evolution-of-the-Alphabet-and-the-Writing-Systems-of-the-World |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604204855/https://www.core77.com/posts/83175/Cool-Charts-Depicting-the-Evolution-of-the-Alphabet-and-the-Writing-Systems-of-the-World |archive-date=2023-06-04 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=[[Core77]]}}</ref> who was born in 1975.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Lee |first=Jenny |date=2015-09-09 |title=Greek mythology? There's a chart for that |url=https://vancouversun.com/business/small%20business/greek-mythology-theres-a-chart-for-that |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240901172018/https://vancouversun.com/business/small%20business/greek-mythology-theres-a-chart-for-that |archive-date=2024-09-01 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=[[Vancouver Sun]] |issn=0832-1299}}</ref> In a YouTube video, Baker said that he was born into a family who were members of the [[Grace Communion International|Worldwide Church of God]]. He described the church as a [[cult]] and has since converted to [[Reform Judaism|Progressive Judaism]].<ref group="‡">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HaKpI7tpryc |title=The Cult I Grew Up In {{!}} British Israelism Debunked |date=2021-04-16 |type=Video |publisher=UsefulCharts |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240822144901/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HaKpI7tpryc |archive-date=2024-08-22 |url-status=live |via=[[YouTube]]}}</ref> In 2003, he cofounded Beacon Hill Academy, a non-profit school in [[Nuwara Eliya]], [[Sri Lanka]], where he had previously worked as a teacher.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Meet Matthew Baker, Useful Charts |url=http://smallbusinessbc.ca/success-story/meet-matthew-baker-useful-charts/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240302175131/http://smallbusinessbc.ca/success-story/meet-matthew-baker-useful-charts/ |archive-date=2024-03-02 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Small Business BC}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=http://www.beaconhillacademy.org/about/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240314180356/http://www.beaconhillacademy.org/about/ |archive-date=2024-03-14 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Beacon Hill Academy}}</ref> When he moved to [[Vancouver]] in 2009, he uploaded around 100 educational charts online covering various topics which earned him money through [[Google AdSense]] advertisements on his website.<ref name=":0" /> He later began selling physical posters on [[Amazon.com]] and was able to rely on income from the UsefulCharts business by 2011.<ref name=":0" />

Baker has a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in education,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Matt Baker |url=https://www.simonandschuster.com/authors/Matt-Baker/174857751 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210126125908/https://www.simonandschuster.com/authors/Matt-Baker/174857751 |archive-date=2021-01-26 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=[[Simonandschuster.com]]}}</ref> with his dissertation titled "Psychological type and atheism: why some people are more likely than others to give up God."<ref name=":0" group="‡" />

== Business ==
The company was started by Matthew Baker on February 2, 2018 with the purpose of turning Matt's hobby of making charts into a business.{{Cn|date=September 2024}}

=== Store ===
The storefront of the company is located at [[Commercial Drive, Vancouver]], where physical posters and books by UsefulCharts are sold.<ref name=":2">{{Cite AV media |url=https://globalnews.ca/video/10100757/charting-vancouvers-history |title=Charting Vancouver's History |date=2023-11-18 |type=Video |publisher=[[Global News]] |access-date=2024-09-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118140918/https://globalnews.ca/video/10100757/charting-vancouvers-history/ |archive-date=2023-11-18 |url-status=live |via=globalnews.ca}}</ref> Posters can also be purchased online through its website.<ref name=":1" />

=== YouTube ===
The company has an associated [[YouTube]] channel where Baker narrates over videos presenting educational charts. Baker has said the revenue between physical chart sales and the channel is "about 50/50." In a [[Global News]] segment covering UsefulCharts, a video detailing the [[history of Vancouver]] was highlighted.<ref name=":2" /> It recently reached 2,000,000 subscribers.

=== Notable charts ===
{{Tall image|Timeline of Ancient History.png|300|200|Timeline of ancient history, uploaded by UsefulCharts to [[Wikimedia Commons]] in 2011.|alt=Timeline of Ancient history}}
Charts designed by the company which have received media attention include:

* ''Evolution of the Alphabet'': a visual timeline of all 26 [[glyph]]s in the [[English alphabet]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite news |last=Wilson |first=Mark |date=2019-01-31 |title=See the amazing evolution of the alphabet, from 1750 BC to today |url=https://www.fastcompany.com/90299301/see-the-amazing-evolution-of-the-alphabet-from-1750-bc-to-today |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221225072144/https://www.fastcompany.com/90299301/see-the-amazing-evolution-of-the-alphabet-from-1750-bc-to-today |archive-date=2022-12-25 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=[[Fast Company]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Frauenfelder |first=Mark |date=2019-01-29 |title=Fascinating chart shows the evolution of the English alphabet from Egyptian hieroglyphics |url=https://boingboing.net/2019/01/29/fascinating-chart-shows-the-ev.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231129224414/https://boingboing.net/2019/01/29/fascinating-chart-shows-the-ev.html |archive-date=2023-11-29 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=[[Boing Boing]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Sierzputowski |first=Kate |date=2019-01-29 |title=Evolution of the Alphabet: Nearly 3,800 Years of Letters Explored Through a Color-Coded Flowchart |url=https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2019/01/evolution-of-the-alphabet/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322035716/https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2019/01/evolution-of-the-alphabet/ |archive-date=2023-03-22 |access-date=2024-09-01 |work=[[Colossal (blog)|Colossal]]}}</ref>
* ''Writing Systems of the World'': a chart detailing [[writing system]]s of various languages.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Marshall |first=Colin |date=2023-10-30 |title=The Writing Systems of the World Explained, from the Latin Alphabet to the Abugidas of India |url=https://www.openculture.com/2023/10/the-writing-systems-of-the-world-explained-from-the-latin-alphabet-to-the-abugidas-of-india.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240826190225/https://www.openculture.com/2023/10/the-writing-systems-of-the-world-explained-from-the-latin-alphabet-to-the-abugidas-of-india.html |archive-date=2024-08-26 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Open Culture}}</ref>

== Reception ==
Biblical scholar [[Jacob L. Wright]] commented on [[Twitter]] in 2024 that Baker was "an extraordinary pedagogue" while sharing a video by UsefulCharts on the [[Twelve Tribes of Israel]].<ref>{{Cite twitter |number=1756658221597565169 |user=JacobLWright |title=Matt Baker is truly an extraordinary pedagogue. @usefulcharts |first=Jacob L. |last=Wright |author-link=Jacob L. Wright |date=2024-02-11 |access-date=2024-09-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240901211032/https://twitter.com/JacobLWright/status/1756658221597565169 |archive-date=2024-09-01 |url-status=live}}</ref> Mark Wilson, writing for ''[[Fast Company]]'', said ''Evolution of the Alphabet'' "beautifully illustrated" the history of the alphabet.<ref name=":3" />
